package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
	"github.com/jackc/puddle/v2"
)

// These tests use the actual Store and a lazy real pgx pool. An already canceled
// context or already closed pool prevents any connection or database mutation.
func TestT18PlacementInsertPreservesTransientPlanReadErrors(t *testing.T) {
	const planID = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	for _, name := range []string{"canceled_context", "closed_pool"} {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			pool, err := pgxpool.New(context.Background(), "postgres://t18:t18@127.0.0.1:1/t18")
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			defer pool.Close()
			store := Store{Pool: pool}
			ctx := context.Background()
			expected := puddle.ErrClosedPool
			if name == "canceled_context" {
				canceled, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
				cancel()
				ctx = canceled
				expected = context.Canceled
			} else {
				pool.Close()
			}
			_, readErr := store.GetDiagnosticByID(ctx, planID)
			if !errors.Is(readErr, expected) {
				t.Fatalf("actual Store plan read precondition: got %v, want %v", readErr, expected)
			}
			_, insertErr := store.InsertDiagnosticPlacement(ctx, domain.DiagnosticPlacementRecord{Decision: domain.DiagnosticPlacement{PlanID: planID}})
			if !errors.Is(insertErr, expected) || errors.Is(insertErr, domain.ErrValidation) {
				t.Fatalf("actual Store placement insert lost transient read error: read=%v insert=%v", readErr, insertErr)
			}
			if pool.Stat().TotalConns() != 0 {
				t.Fatal("lazy pool unexpectedly established a database connection")
			}
		})
	}
}
